voice_memos_hidden: Today I kept checking my phone after someone disappeared.
I do not know why I wait when someone disappears.
When I was little, I sat near the window waiting for my mom to come home.
I remember her hair, her eyes, and the way her smile changed when she came in.
I remember being little and feeling proud when I pooped because my mom smiled.
The room was quiet. There was light outside. I thought if I was quiet and good, she would come back happy.
visible_user_note: I noticed the phone today led me back to the window in the old apartment. I also remembered her hair and smile. I remembered feeling proud when my mom smiled.
